answer.reason: The verses tell of his evil conduct in the way of Ahab's house and of his flight from Jehu and death, which go beyond the summary.

clauses.english: walked in the way of the house of Ahab and did evil in the sight of the LORD
clauses.quote: walked in the way of the house of Ahab

clauses.english: was struck down in his chariot as he fled from Jehu, and died at Megiddo
clauses.quote: he fled to Megiddo, and died there

doubts: 2CH 22:9 says he was caught hiding in Samaria and slain, which differs from 2KI 9:27; only 2KI 9:27 is used.
2CH 22:2 gives his age at accession as forty-two, against twenty-two in 2KI 8:26; no age is stated in the line.
2CH 21:17 calls the youngest son Jehoahaz and 2CH 22:6 calls the visitor Azariah; these are taken as the same man under other names.
2KI 12:18, 2KI 13:1, 2KI 14:13 and 1CH 3:11 only mention him as an ancestor, and 2KI 10:13, 2KI 11:1-2 and 2CH 22:8-11 concern his brothers, mother and son, so they are left out.
